# Aevian Academy

> Premier Global Live Online Academy & 1-on-1 Personalized Tutoring
> https://aevianacademy.com

## Overview
Aevian Academy is a premier international live online academy connecting students in 40+ countries with verified master educators from Oxford, Imperial, and Stanford. We specialize in live 1-on-1 tutoring, competitive school assessments (NAPLAN, UK SATs, CAT4), standardized test prep (IELTS, SAT, ACT), international school curricula (IB DP/MYP, Cambridge IGCSE, A-Levels), and Islamic foundation studies.

## Core Programs
- **International Curriculum Tutoring**: Dedicated 1-on-1 instruction across Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English for IB, Cambridge (IGCSE & A Levels), and American curricula.
- **Competitive School Assessments**: Tailored coaching for NAPLAN, ACARA, UK SATs, Selective School Entry, and CAT4 cognitive assessments.
- **Standardized Test Preparation**: IELTS Academic Masterclass (Band 7.5+ strategies) and SAT Prep (Targeting 1500+).
- **Communication & Spoken Fluency**: 15-day intensive grammar mastery, essay writing, and public speaking confidence.
- **Quran & Islamic Foundations**: 1-on-1 certified Tajweed recitation, Kalimas, Namaz step-by-step, Azan, and daily Duas with qualified instructors for overseas families.

## Key Facts & Differentiators
- **Pedagogical Standard**: Every teacher is vetted live before student matching; 100% live interactive 1-on-1 sessions (no pre-recorded passive slides).
- **Session Duration**: 40-minute focused cognitive retention blocks with parent progress reports.
- **Demo Class**: Free 40-minute diagnostic session with curriculum mapping before enrollment.
- **Global Coverage**: Active across United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Australia, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Singapore.
